name: Pulsar Ripple Button
description: A button with quantum ripple effect that calculates mouse click offset and displays animated pulsar waves on click.
code: import React from "react"; export const PulsarButton = ({ onClick, children }) => { const handleClick = (e) => { const circle = document.createElement("span"); const diameter = Math.max(e.currentTarget.clientWidth, e.currentTarget.clientHeight); const radius = diameter / 2; const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect(); circle.style.width = circle.style.height = `${diameter}px`; circle.style.left = `${e.clientX - rect.left - radius}px`; circle.style.top = `${e.clientY - rect.top - radius}px`; circle.className = "absolute rounded-full bg-white/40 pointer-events-none animate-ping"; circle.style.animationDuration = "0.6s"; e.currentTarget.appendChild(circle); setTimeout(() => circle.remove(), 600); onClick?.(e); }; return ( ); };
